title: B1 · L21 — Future perfect
topic: Future perfect: will have + past participle
description: El future perfect ('will have + participio') expresa una acción que estará completada antes de un momento específico del futuro.

questions.prompt: Le informas a tu jefe del avance de un proyecto.
questions.question: Complete: 'By next month, I ___ my project.'
questions.explanation: Future perfect ('will have + participio') → acción COMPLETADA antes de un momento futuro. 'By next month' establece ese punto. Error típico del hispanohablante: usar 'will finish' que sugiere acabar EN ese momento, no antes. 'By' + future perfect = 'para ese momento ya estará hecho'.
examples: By 2030, they will have built a completely new stadium. → hito futuro completado
By the end of the year, we will have saved enough for the trip. → meta cumplida

questions.prompt: Coordinas la cena con un amigo que llega tarde.
questions.question: Choose: 'By the time you arrive, I ___ dinner.'
questions.explanation: 'By the time + present simple' se combina con future perfect: la acción de cocinar se COMPLETARÁ antes de tu llegada. Error típico: usar 'will cook' que sugiere que empezaré a cocinar cuando llegues. Regla: 'by the time' → future perfect casi obligatorio para orden temporal claro.
examples: By the time she calls, I'll have already left the office. → orden secuencial
By the time the film starts, we'll have eaten dinner. → acción completada antes

questions.statement: The future perfect emphasises that an action will be finished before a specific future time.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. El future perfect se enfoca en la CULMINACIÓN de una acción antes de otro momento futuro, no en su duración ni en el momento exacto. Estructura: 'will have + participio'. Marcadores típicos: by, by the time, by then, by [año/momento].
examples: By 5 p.m., I'll have written the whole report. → completado antes de la hora
By next year, they'll have moved abroad. → hito futuro cumplido

questions.text: By the end of this year I will have lived here for a decade.
questions.explanation: Nota la contracción típica 'I'll have lived' /aɪl həv lɪvd/ en habla natural — 'have' se reduce a schwa casi imperceptible. 'A decade' con acento en /ˈdek/. Future perfect + 'for + periodo' expresa cuánto tiempo llevará algo al llegar a un punto futuro. Muy usado en hitos personales.
examples: By 2025 I'll have worked here for 10 years — incredible thought. → hito laboral
By July we'll have known each other for 20 years, honestly. → hito relacional

questions.prompt: Motivas a tus alumnos hablando de lo que habrán aprendido al final del curso.
questions.question: Complete: 'By the end of the course, we ___ 50 grammar topics.'
questions.explanation: Future perfect con 'by the end of' → acción COMPLETADA antes del final del curso. Al terminar el curso, esos 50 temas ya estarán cubiertos. 'Will study' es futuro puntual; 'will be studying' es acción en curso; presente no encaja aquí.
examples: By the end of the week, I'll have finished the whole book. → meta a corto plazo
By the end of the month, we'll have saved £500 for the trip. → hito financiero

questions.prompt: Empareja cada elemento con su descripción:

pairs.right: by, by the time, by then

pairs.left: Duration up to a future point

questions.explanation: El future perfect describe acciones COMPLETADAS antes de un punto futuro, o DURACIONES que se cumplirán al llegar ese punto. Marcadores clave: by (para/antes de), by the time (para cuando), by then (para entonces). También admite for/since para hitos de duración acumulada.
examples: By 2030 we'll have moved to a bigger house. → acción completada
By June I'll have worked here for 5 years. → duración acumulada

questions.prompt: Identifica la frase con future perfect bien construida.
questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: By next Friday, I will finished the report.
By next Friday, I will have finish the report.
By next Friday, I will have finished the report.
By next Friday, I have finished the report.
questions.explanation: La estructura correcta es 'will HAVE + PARTICIPIO'. Errores: (A) falta 'have'; (B) 'finish' sin participio; (D) falta 'will' — sería present perfect sin futuro. Solo la opción C respeta la fórmula fija completa.
examples: I'll have completed the task by Monday morning. → estructura correcta
She'll have graduated by June — huge milestone. → fórmula estándar

questions.target: By the time I'm forty, I'll have travelled to over thirty countries, honestly — that's the plan.
questions.explanation: Situación: compartes ambiciones vitales en una conversación profunda. Future perfect con 'by the time + present simple' para expresar metas acumuladas. 'Honestly' + 'that's the plan' añaden autenticidad. Perfecto para hablar de ambiciones a medio/largo plazo.
examples: By the time I'm 30, I'll have finished my master's degree, hopefully. → hito académico
By the time we retire, we'll have saved enough money to travel the world. → hito financiero

questions.statement: 'By 2030 I will have finished university' is a correct future perfect sentence.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. 'By + año/momento futuro + will have + participio' es la estructura PERFECTA. Indica que la acción se completará antes de ese año/momento. Todos los elementos están: marcador temporal 'by 2030', auxiliar 'will have', participio 'finished'.
examples: By 2028 they'll have built the new bridge across the river. → proyecto futuro
By December I'll have saved £2000 for the holidays. → meta financiera

questions.prompt: Avisas a tu pareja que volveréis tarde de una cena.
questions.question: Complete: 'By the time we get home, the kids ___ to sleep.'
questions.explanation: Los niños se dormirán ANTES de nuestra llegada → future perfect ordena los eventos: primero se duermen, después llegamos. 'Will go' sugiere que se irán a dormir cuando lleguemos; 'will be going' sería el proceso en curso.
examples: By the time you arrive, we'll have started dinner. → orden claro
By the time they call, I'll have already left the office. → acción anterior

questions.text: By next summer we will have been married for exactly ten years.
questions.explanation: Nota la contracción típica 'we'll have been' — 'have' débil /əv/ casi imperceptible. 'Exactly ten' con acento en 'exactly'. Future perfect + 'for + periodo' para hitos personales de relaciones. La duración se acumula hasta el momento futuro.
examples: By next year we'll have been together for five years. → hito relacional
By December I'll have worked here for two decades — wow. → hito laboral

questions.prompt: Identifica la frase con error en future perfect.
questions.question: Which sentence is INCORRECT?
options: By 5 pm I will have called him.
By tomorrow we will have finished.
By next year they will have moved.
questions.explanation: 'I will finished' es INCORRECTO: falta el auxiliar 'have'. La forma correcta es 'I will HAVE finished'. Este error es TOP-2 en hispanohablantes porque en español no existe una construcción tan compleja para el futuro perfecto — se calca mal.
examples: By 2030 I'll have finished school and started my career. → forma correcta
By next month I'll have paid off my student loan. → estructura completa

questions.statement: The future perfect is often used with 'by then' when the future point has already been mentioned.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. 'By then' resume un momento futuro mencionado antes en el discurso. Se combina naturalmente con future perfect para acciones ya completadas para ese momento. Evita repetir el momento específico y suena más fluido.
examples: I retire in 2050. By then I'll have saved enough to travel forever. → 'by then' resume
The film starts at 8. By then we'll have finished dinner. → referencia previa

questions.prompt: Escribes una nota que dejas antes de irte de casa.
questions.question: Complete: 'By the time you read this, I ___ already.'
questions.explanation: Future perfect + 'already' → acción COMPLETADA antes del momento futuro (cuando leas esto). 'Will leave' sugeriría que me iré cuando leas la nota; 'am leaving' es presente para futuro planeado (menos preciso aquí).
examples: By the time you get home, I'll have already gone to bed. → acción completada
By the time she calls, I'll have already replied to her email. → orden temporal

questions.target: By the end of next year, honestly, I'll have paid off all my student loans — I can't wait.
questions.explanation: Situación: compartes con orgullo una meta financiera a punto de cumplirse. Future perfect con hito personal ('paid off all my student loans'). 'Honestly' + 'I can't wait' añaden autenticidad emocional. Muy útil para hablar de metas a mediano plazo cumplibles.
examples: By the end of the month I'll have saved £500 — small victories. → meta mensual
By December we'll have bought our first house, fingers crossed. → hito vital + esperanza
